name: FUN_PARALLEL_CHUNKS
description: This table contains the details of the chunks that are created to breakup the candidate data for a parallel job.

columns.name: PARALLEL_RUN_ID
columns.description: Parallel run to which this chunk belongs.

columns.name: PARENT_CHUNK_ID
columns.description: Parent chunk identifier for this chunk. When there is no parent chunk, it contains the current chunk identifier.

columns.name: PHASE_CODE
columns.description: Phase to which this chunk belongs.

columns.name: CHUNK_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the chunk. Possible values are READY, IN PROCESS, COMPLETED, and ERROR.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority of the data in the chunk.

columns.name: SPLIT_VALUE
columns.description: Split value of the data in the chunk.

columns.name: CHUNK_SIZE
columns.description: Current chunk size. It accounts for the cost of all of the data assigned to the chunk.

columns.name: DESIRED_CHUNK_SIZE
columns.description: Desired chunk size, based on calculations done at chunk creation time.

columns.name: AVAILABILITY_TIME
columns.description: Date and time when a job can select the chunk for processing.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier for the Enterprise Service Scheduler job that selects the chunk for processing.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ATTEMPTS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of times the chunk has been selected for processing.
